units.source_text: “噢，小花纹什么的，打算做内衣吗？”

en.t: "Oh, little patterns and the like, are you planning to make underwear?"

units.source_text: 父亲望着女儿，用笑支吾过去，“爸爸为了答谢你，给你画张樟树图案做和服或外褂。

en.t: Her father looked at his daughter and laughed it off. "To thank you, Papa will draw you a camphor-tree pattern for a kimono or an outer coat.
When you wear it, you will surely look like a fairy..."
